name: Npc Vendor Template
description: A reusable list of items for sale that can be shared by multiple vendor creatures via creature_template.VendorTemplateId, instead of repeating the same item list in npc_vendor for each entry. Per-creature npc_vendor rows are added on top of the template list.

fields.name: Entry
fields.help: Vendor template id, referenced from creature_template.VendorTemplateId (not a creature entry itself).

fields.name: Max Count
fields.help: Limited stock: maximum number of this item available at once, 0 = unlimited. If set, Incr Time must be non-zero.

fields.name: Incr Time
fields.help: Restock time in seconds for one unit of a limited-stock item. Must be 0 when Max Count is 0, non-zero otherwise.

fields.name: Slot
fields.help: Only defines the ordering of items in the vendor window (rows are loaded ORDER BY slot).

fields.name: Condition Id
fields.help: conditions.condition_entry controlling whether this item is offered to a given player, 0 = always offered.

fields.name: Condition
fields.help: Edit the condition tree referenced by Condition Id.
